This cert mentions "This instrument has been evaluated using the modular approach from R 76-1 (2006) clause 3.10.2 and Annex C." Hmm, but it's a complete weighing instrument, not just modules. The certificate is for a complete instrument. The scheme field expects "A" or "B". Scheme B is "OIML Certificate of Conformity for modules of a measuring instrument" — this cert is for a complete instrument type, so scheme A. Actually, wait — R76 certificates under the old OIML MAA... The cert says "This Certificate attests the conformity of the above identified Type... with the requirements of OIML R 76". It's a complete instrument certificate → scheme A.

Hmm, but the modular approach mention... Still it's a complete instrument. Scheme A.
